svg.title: Two stacked bars of price impact. Holding back, each program buys 30 blocks and the price closes halfway to the true value, leaving 60p per block, so each earns £18.00. Trading hard, each buys 40 blocks and the price closes two-thirds of the way up, leaving 40p per block, so each earns £16.00.
